newsitem.title: UK: UK shares shy from near-record high as Dow dithers.
newsitem.headline: UK shares shy from near-record high as Dow dithers.

text.p: UK shares dipped on Wednesday from the near record levels reached earlier in the week as inflation jitters unsettled Wall Street and selected UK stocks succumbed to profit-taking after recent strong gains.

The FTSE 100 closed down 10.5 points at 3,905.6, after yesteday ending 2.7 points short of a new peak. Losers were in a seven-to-two majority, with RTZ hit by a drop in shares of Australian partner CRA and Grand Met weak on downgrade talk.
Trading volume continued the recent thin trend and dealers said activity was cautious ahead of today's Beige Book economic report from the U.S. Federal Reserve.
